### 2026-10-18 – I spent time researching parts to buy for the non 3d printed pieces. I settled on N20 Dc motors, and a driver to control them.

**1h**

I spent time researching parts to buy for the non 3d printed pieces. I settled on N20 Dc motors, and a driver to control them.

For the rollers grip, I am using silicon O-rings.

I will use a Arduino Nano I have already to control the project.

I also had a lot of parts on hand so that is why they are marked as $0 on the BOM

The photos included show my carts for if I was buying everything new, but most of the stuff has already be purchased.
